3. Demonstrate failure or success of test result to meet specifications.
4. Find or generate a customer complaint that complains this performance.
5. Find or generate sales report records to show product defects and repair costs.
6. Find or generate warranty data to show failure over time.
7. Find people to accuse.
8. Write false specifications that match the performance.
9. Write a report to give the appearance of following specified standard and include these model and customer complaint in it.
10. Find manager to approve it.
11. Give the report to the manager, attach previous and modified specifications for modification record, attach previous test result for modification record and attach customer complaint lists to suggest further analysis to the sales team.
